title.narrative: Grant Management to Improve the Scientific and Technical Knowledge Base of Climate Change in Gabon – Readiness and Preparatory Support Programme of the Green Climate Fund (GCF)

description.narrative: Gabon has developed an overarching proposal for a robust National Adaptation Plan for Climate Change. It has two phases: to collect, capture, and analyze climate data across the country and to develop a comprehensive adaptation plan that strengthens the country’s overall resilience to address prioritized climate impacts. The overall objective of this project is to improve the scientific and technical knowledge base of climate change in Gabon.\n\nThe Green Climate Fund (GCF) Readiness programme is a funding programme to enhance country ownership and access to the Fund. UNOPS assists the work of the GCF through grant support management services.
